name: deep-research
description: Multi-step research on a question: parallel web sweeps, source fetches, then one cited report.

steps.promptTemplate: Research question: ${input}. Run WebSearch with 3-5 distinct query variants (different phrasings, English and the question's original language). From all results, pick the 10 most promising distinct URLs and return a numbered list: URL — one line on why it matters. If WebSearch is unavailable, say so explicitly and list URLs you already know, marking them as unverified.

For each promising URL in: ${steps.search-wide} — fetch it with WebFetch (question: what does this source say about ${input}?). Extract the concrete claims relevant to the question with a one-line note per claim. Skip dead or paywalled links honestly (say which and why). Return per-URL findings.

Write the final research report for the question: ${input}. Structure: (1) the answer in 2-4 sentences; (2) findings, each with its source URL in parentheses; (3) open questions the sources did not settle. Use only what is in: ${steps.fetch-sources}. No invented citations.
